verdict.rationale: macOS documents Spotlight as a built-in launcher that can 'search and take action without opening apps', with an 'Ask Siri' option in Spotlight results. That covers the launcher half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows system-wide hotkeys, full keyboard navigation of the UI, or keyboard-driven window management. Third-party tools (Moom, Keyboard Maestro) and key remapping via hidutil are workarounds or adjacent features and earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented global hotkeys/keyboard shortcuts, full keyboard access to all UI controls, keyboard-driven window tiling and management, and hands-on corroboration of keyboard-only operation.
